      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Extend the early block/undo data availability check to non-pruned nodes to avoid copying the UTXO set before failing rollback",
      "quote": "Should the early availability check also cover non-pruned nodes? They can load a snapshot without having the historical block or undo data.",
      "clears_with": "answer",

      "status_note": "",

      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Generalize the error message to state required block or undo data is unavailable rather than pruned",
      "quote": "Would a more general error message describe these cases better? Specifically, changing: Could not roll back to requested height since necessary block data is already pruned. to: Could not roll back to requested height because required block or undo data is unavailable.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],

    {

      "part": 3,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Compare the missing-data boundary against target height using > instead of >= to avoid rejecting valid rollbacks to the target height",
      "quote": "Could the boundary eventually compare the highest missing-data height against the target using `>` instead of `>=`? The loop in `CreateRolledBackUTXOSnapshot` uses: `while (block_index->nHeight > target->nHeight)`",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],

    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:5492606225",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "The fix looks straightforward and contained: `GetPruneHeight` handles missing data at the tip before calling `GetFirstBlock`, allowing the RPC to return an error instead of hitting the assertion.",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "both",

        "GetPruneHeight",
        "GetFirstBlock",

}
